summary: The review is proportional to the change: a new script decides which lenses a change needs — correctness, quality and tests always, security whenever the change touches external input, I/O, queries, HTML rendering, authentication, secrets, configuration, dependencies or a sensitive path, and is otherwise left out with the reason in the review report — groups them into two reviewers under 150 changed lines, and writes one review pack (files changed, criteria in force, test report, code diff) that every reviewer reads first instead of gathering the same context on its own. New settings review.select_lenses, review.group_below_lines and review.sensitive_paths.
